extension.news: v3.2.0 - New startup intro: the provider logos circle the screen faster and faster, burst into their colours and reveal the Deflix name - The loading circle no longer shows over the intro - Sidebar: new HBO Max, Paramount+ and Crunchyroll hubs, each with its own theme and rows v3.1.1 - Title pages: the Watch Later button now sits below More Episodes v3.1.0 - KDMM, the add-on that plays movies and episodes, now installs with the skin and becomes TMDb Bingie Helper's default player - Netflix hub: its own dark red theme, like Prime Video and Disney+ - The sidebar takes the colour of the provider hub that is open - Row names say what the rows hold: Lucasfilm, Walt Disney Pictures, Marvel Studios, Original Series, Action Movies and more - First-run screens rewritten for the provider hubs, Trakt and KDMM, with a Connect Trakt button v3.0.0 - New sidebar: Search, Home, Prime Video, Netflix, Apple TV and Disney+, replacing the Movies, TV, New, Categories, My List and Surprise Me hubs - Each provider hub lists its catalogue from TMDb (Top 100 movies and shows, originals, new titles, genres) and has its own colour theme - New row styles: ranked rows with large numerals and large landscape cards - Home now shows your Trakt rows: continue watching, watch later, recently watched and recommendations - Watch Later button on title pages (your Trakt watchlist) - Title pages scroll as one page into the collection and "More like this" rows - Menus and rows customised in 2.x are reset to the new defaults once - The Deflix repository now also provides the Bingie add-ons the skin needs v2.3.0 - Remove the unused Inter font set and its 10 MB of font files; the Default (Netflix Sans) and Arial font sets remain v2.2.1 - Fix empty Home menu after a skin update: rebuild menus when the main menu has no items
